newsitem.title: UK: Two of 11 June N.Sea Flotta cargoes cancelled - trade.
newsitem.headline: Two of 11 June N.Sea Flotta cargoes cancelled - trade.

text.p: Britain's North Sea Flotta crude system will load two fewer cargoes in June than expected, traders said on Wednesday.
Traders said a 500,000-barrel cargo due to load June 15-17 and a 600,000-barrel cargo due to load June 24-25 were cancelled, cutting the June programme to 5.3 million barrels in nine cargoes.
Traders said the first cargo belonged to LASMO North Sea Plc and the second to Conoco U.K.
The cargoes were cancelled after expectations of production in June at Conoco's MacCulloch field were revised down, they said.

Conoco said last month it was delaying first production at MacCulloch, originally expected in December 1996, until the end of May because bad weather had hampered commissioning of the floating production vessel North Sea Producer.
The delays had already caused the cancellation of a cargo from the May programme. The revised programme scheduled 4.85 million barrels in eight cargoes.

Conoco said on Wednesday it was unaware of any fresh delays to the start-up of MacCulloch, which is expected to reach peak production of 50-60,000 barrels per day (bpd) feeding the Flotta terminal on the Orkney Islands.
